Alternative filters - worth trying.  I have a Kenmore Elite with both an air and water filter.  6 months into my purchase, my fridge alerted me to needing to replace both.  I looked at Sears and was shocked by the price of both, so of course, I looked at Amazon and found these filters.  The reviews seemed to indicate they would work, so I decided to give it a try.  In two days, the filters were at my door.  I twisted off the cover in the fridge and these filters look similar, without the additional cloth filter that came with the original OEM.  A few weeks in, it seems to be keeping items in my fridge fresh just like the original.  I will buy these again when I need replacement filters.
